notes.title: 7 Sexy Sins V1.2 (Released 09/08/2019)
notes.content:
Update 09/08/2019
New Localization :
- Added Simplified Chinese Localization. While in game's main menu, go to Settings (gear icon) -> Language (3rd tab). Click on Simplified Chinese (4th option) then close the window to change the game's language.
Misc. :
- Added clothed characters CGs. An image of fully clothed sexy sin will be added to your album folder after your start each level.
- Readjusted 'level complete' image size and compositions. You can replay and complete each level to obtain the adjusted images.
(While in main menu, go to Album (book icon) -> 'Full CG' button to open the folder containing your acquired images.)

notes.title: 7 Sexy Sins V1.1 (Released 03/05/2019)
notes.content:
Update 03/05/2019
New Features :
- Added 'Full CG' button to album page in main menu. The button will bring you to a folder containing the full size images of the photos in your album.
Technical Fixs :
- Fixed enemy's death explosion sound effect not adjusted by SFX setting.
Gameplay Fixs :
- Reduced player's hit box size.
- Changed Gula's bite attack's startup to make it less sudden and more predictable.
- Made saliva bubbles' hitboxes during Gula's bite attack disappear sooner.
- Changed Kimochia's locking circle attack's visual to make it more visible.
- Increased the radius of Kimochia's circle locking attack.
- Increased Lucille's beam attack startup time.
- Increased the distance between each fireball column created from Lucille's sword attack.
- Decreased Lucille's sword attack swing speed.
- Increased Lucille's recovery time after sword attack.
- Decreased number of fireballs during Satano's pentagram attack.
- Increased the starting size of fireballs during Satano's pentagram attack.
